summary: Added a bounded single Docker stats collection to enrich running containers with current CPU and memory usage without treating unavailable or malformed stats as zero.
completed: Added one docker stats --no-stream collection for all running containers
Parsed CPU, memory used, limit, and percentage
Preserved container metadata when stats are absent or malformed
